t: This is St Mary of the Angels, a Roman Catholic church on Moorhouse Road in Bayswater. It sits within the City of Westminster, though the parish it serves is partly in Westminster and partly in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. The architect was John Francis Bentley, an ecclesiastical architect best known for Westminster Cathedral, which he built in a style heavily influenced by Byzantine architecture. So this is a church by the man behind one of London's most famous Catholic landmarks.
